title: My Dad Said My Games Were Killing Our Wi-Fi #shorts

cast.kid: a stick-figure boy with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, short spiky brown hair and an orange hoodie
cast.dad: a stick-figure father with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, a short black beard, thick eyebrows and a gray sweater

lines.text: "Your games keep killing our Wi-Fi," Dad said, so were my games the guilty ones?
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone on a bedroom floor holding exactly one game controller, looking up worried, one glowing TV behind him

lines.text: Every night at dinner, Dad's favorite show froze and spun at the very best part.
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone on a living room couch with one dinner bowl on his lap, staring angrily at one frozen TV

lines.text: "It always freezes the second I get my dinner, while you game upstairs," he said.
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing alone at the bottom of a staircase, pointing up the stairs, frowning

lines.text: "So your console goes in my closet, and it stays there for a whole month."
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, walking alone toward a hallway closet carrying exactly one game console under one arm, stern face

lines.text: The very next night, with my console locked in his closet, his show froze again.
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone on a couch holding one dinner bowl, mouth open at one frozen TV screen

lines.text: "Then it's your phone," Dad said, and took it too, but his show still froze.
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing alone in a hallway holding up exactly one phone in one hand, eyebrows raised, annoyed

lines.text: I sat on the stairs with nothing to play, blamed for something I never did.
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone on a staircase hugging his knees, sad, a tear on his cheek

lines.text: So I wrote down every freeze, and every single one began right after a beep.
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone at the top of a staircase writing in exactly one small notebook, one hand cupped to his ear, listening hard

lines.text: The beep was the microwave starting up, heating Dad's dinner right as his show froze.
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, standing alone in a kitchen, pointing at exactly one glowing microwave oven, eyes wide

lines.text: Microwave ovens use nearly the same radio waves as Wi-Fi, and a little leaks out.
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, standing alone in a kitchen, exactly one microwave oven on the counter giving off soft wavy lines toward one small router on a shelf

lines.text: I ran a speed test, Dad warmed his soup, and the speed dropped to nothing.
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing alone in a kitchen beside exactly one running microwave oven, staring at one phone in his hand, jaw dropped

lines.text: My games were innocent, so the console came back, and the microwave got grounded instead.
lines.image: {kid} is the only person in the picture, sitting alone on a bedroom floor happily playing a video game with exactly one controller, one glowing TV in front of him, warm evening light
